reason: No safe full-intake isolation or fake-provider/WAV-input entry point in the final desktop build. Capture mode bypasses the workers and cannot test restart.
evidence: Runtime/TrialReviewApp.cs Start reads shared PlayerPrefs; --intake calls OpenIntake.
Runtime/TrialReviewIntake.cs OpenIntake restores ParticipantIntakeFolder from shared PlayerPrefs and calls ConnectLive.
Runtime/TrialReviewIntake.cs StartAnswer requests microphone authorization and calls Microphone.Start; no WAV input hook.
Runtime/TrialReviewLive.cs InitializeLive defaults to Documents/Trial Review Live; --live-output only isolates bridge output, not PlayerPrefs/catalog/session or keys.
Runtime/TrialReviewCapture.cs capture-only path disables jobs and capture, so it cannot validate resumable intake.
prepare.py packages real workers, with no fake-provider mode.
